feature_policy: Only the explicit row.features object is eligible for discovery. Identifiers and point-in-time aggregates calculated strictly before each buy are allowed; outcomes, returns, delays, holding duration, fees, and post-event matching fields are rejected.

allow_list.name: wallet_address
allow_list.justification: Wallet identity is the predeclared CopyTrade independence group, not a return-based selection feature.

allow_list.name: token_symbol
allow_list.justification: Token label is copied from the normalized GMGN round-trip record.

allow_list.name: signal_type
allow_list.justification: Source-normalized signal type is stored at capture.

allow_list.name: token_address
allow_list.justification: Token identity is part of the captured source record.

allow_list.name: chain
allow_list.justification: Chain identity is part of the captured source record.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_trade_count
allow_list.justification: Count of stored wallet buy/sell rows strictly before the current buy event.

allow_list.name: prior_token_trade_count
allow_list.justification: Count of stored token buy/sell rows strictly before the current buy event.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_buy_volume_usd
allow_list.justification: Sum of positive recorded buy cost_usd for this wallet strictly before the current buy event.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_buy_count
allow_list.justification: Count of wallet buy rows strictly before the current buy event.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_sell_count
allow_list.justification: Count of wallet sell rows strictly before the current buy event.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_sell_volume_usd
allow_list.justification: Sum of recorded wallet sell volume strictly before the current buy event.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_realized_profit_usd
allow_list.justification: Realized wallet profit accumulated strictly before the current buy event.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_median_return_percent
allow_list.justification: Median return of earlier wallet trades strictly before the current buy event.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_win_rate_percent
allow_list.justification: Win rate of earlier wallet trades strictly before the current buy event.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_positive_day_percent
allow_list.justification: Share of earlier wallet trading days with positive results.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_best_token_profit_share_percent
allow_list.justification: Largest earlier token profit as a share of earlier wallet profit.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_median_hold_seconds
allow_list.justification: Median holding time of earlier wallet trades strictly before the current buy event.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_under_15_seconds_percent
allow_list.justification: Share of earlier wallet trades held under 15 seconds.

allow_list.name: prior_wallet_paired_trade_count
allow_list.justification: Count of earlier wallet trades with a matched buy/sell pair.
